svg.aria-label: Closure test: how well is a known wall recovered?
svg.text: Closure test: how well is a known wall recovered?
Seven bumps and dents on a known wall, a noisy synthetic scan traced from it, then the same inversion pipeline. Both maps share one colour scale.
Both walls give the same response map within the noise (residual 0.78%), yet the walls correlate at only 0.18: true unevenness 48 µm, recovered 7 µm. The scan does not
